entity.description: Registry of one-time data migrations. Seed data: adding a migration is one row. Explicit registration rather than a naming-convention scan because the six existing migrations use three different verbs (migrate#, sweep#, clear#) while sweep# also names a recurring watchdog that must never run as part of an upgrade.

field.name: componentName
field.description: Owning component. Exists so sibling components can register into the same supervisor later without a schema change.

field.name: description
field.description: Shown on the admin screen: what an operator needs in order to decide.

field.name: supportsDryRun
field.description: 'Y' when the service accepts a dryRun parameter. Starts 'N' for every migration that shipped before dry-run support existed; each flips its own flag as it is retrofitted.

entity.description: Migrations that must have succeeded before this one may run. Verified, never sorted on — sequenceNum determines order, these rows determine permission, and keeping them separate avoids a topological sort while still failing loudly if the declared order and the declared dependencies disagree.
One attempt at one migration. runId is part of the key so a failed attempt is never overwritten by a later retry: a table holding only successes answers "what worked" but not "what is wrong here".

field.name: statusId
field.description: SUCCESS | FAILED | BLOCKED | DRY_RUN. Only SUCCESS satisfies the "already applied" check.

field.name: messageDetail
field.description: Sanitized service messages or error detail. text-very-long rather than text-long for the MySQL row-size limit. Never credentials or raw request secrets.
